components.css: .ds-nav{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:26px;min-height:46px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--rule,#dcded5)}.ds-nav button{align-self:stretch;border:0;border-bottom:2px solid transparent;background:none;padding:12px 0;color:var(--muted,#62645b);font:400 13px/1.5 var(--font,-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",Roboto,"Helvetica Neue",Arial,sans-serif);white-space:nowrap;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color .15s ease-out,color .15s ease-out}.ds-nav button[aria-pressed="true"]{border-bottom-color:var(--copper,#ac4d2b);color:var(--copper,#ac4d2b);font-weight:650}.ds-nav button:hover{color:var(--ink,#242b28)}.ds-nav button:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--focus,#1f678d);outline-offset:4px;}.ds-nav button:active:not(:disabled){filter:brightness(.93)}@media(max-width:760px){.ds-nav{gap:25px}}@media(max-width:540px){.ds-nav{justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;min-height:50px}.ds-nav button{font-size:12px}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-nav button{transition:none}}

components.css: .ds-metrics{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));margin:0;padding:16px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--rule,#dcded5);border-bottom:1px solid var(--rule,#dcded5);color:var(--ink,#242b28);font-family:var(--font,-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",Roboto,"Helvetica Neue",Arial,sans-serif)}.ds-metrics>div{min-width:0;padding:0 24px;border-right:1px solid var(--rule,#dcded5)}.ds-metrics>div:first-child{padding-left:0}.ds-metrics>div:last-child{padding-right:0;border-right:0}.ds-metrics dt{color:var(--muted,#62645b);font-size:11px;font-weight:650;letter-spacing:.03em;text-transform:uppercase}.ds-metrics dd{margin:6px 0 0;font-size:34px;font-weight:650;letter-spacing:-.03em;line-height:1.2;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}.ds-metrics small{display:block;margin-top:4px;font-size:10px;line-height:1.4;color:var(--muted,#62645b)}.ds-denominator{font-size:20px;font-weight:450;color:var(--muted,#62645b);letter-spacing:0}@media(max-width:1050px){.ds-metrics>div{padding:0 18px}}@media(max-width:760px){.ds-metrics{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));padding:0}.ds-metrics>div{padding:18px}.ds-metrics>div:nth-child(odd){padding-left:0}.ds-metrics>div:nth-child(even){border-right:0}.ds-metrics>div:nth-child(-n+2){border-bottom:1px solid var(--rule,#dcded5)}.ds-metrics dd{font-size:36px}}@media(max-width:540px){.ds-metrics dt{font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.01em}.ds-metrics dd{font-size:32px}.ds-denominator{font-size:18px}}

components.css: .ds-route-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:35px minmax(20px,1fr) minmax(50px,160px) 65px;align-items:center;gap:12px;width:100%;border:0;border-top:1px solid var(--rule,#dcded5);border-bottom:1px solid var(--rule,#dcded5);background:none;padding:12px 0;text-align:left;color:var(--ink,#242b28);font:400 15px/1.5 var(--font,-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",Roboto,"Helvetica Neue",Arial,sans-serif);cursor:pointer;transition:background-color .15s ease-out,color .15s ease-out}.ds-route-row:hover{background:var(--surface,#f2f0ea)}.ds-route-row:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--focus,#1f678d);outline-offset:4px;}.ds-route-row:active:not(:disabled){filter:brightness(.93)}.ds-route-row:disabled{opacity:.55;cursor:default}.ds-route-id{font-size:13px;font-weight:650}.ds-route-name{font-size:11px;color:var(--muted,#62645b);overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}.ds-route-row svg{width:100%;height:12px}.ds-bar-track{fill:var(--surface,#f2f0ea)}.ds-bar-fill{fill:var(--copper,#ac4d2b)}.ds-bar-number{text-align:right;font-size:12px;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}@media(max-width:1050px){.ds-route-row{grid-template-columns:28px minmax(10px,1fr) minmax(45px,100px) 60px;gap:8px}}@media(max-width:760px){.ds-route-row{grid-template-columns:32px minmax(25px,1fr) minmax(100px,220px) 65px}.ds-route-name{font-size:12px}}@media(max-width:540px){.ds-route-row{grid-template-columns:28px minmax(25px,1fr) 90px 55px;gap:6px}.ds-route-name,.ds-bar-number{font-size:11px}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-route-row{transition:none}}

narrative.overview:
A warm, restrained transit notebook pairs paper surfaces and charcoal ink with compact quantitative views. Copper identifies the main action and selected views; typography and fine rules organize the information. The supplied CTA Bus Speed Scorecard establishes this personal project's visual family.

Condensed display headings give the notebook its identity. Familiar system text, native fields, tabular figures, and direct explanations carry the working interface. Flat surfaces leave charts, route comparisons, raw observations, and provenance easy to inspect. The implementation is code-led and ships no decorative raster imagery.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper and charcoal ink, with copper actions and blue secondary data.
Self-hosted condensed display headings above quiet system text.
Flat ruled sections, compact native controls, and aligned numerical comparisons.
Readable chart axes, contained horizontal scrolling, and inspectable source evidence.

rules.name: The Functional Accent Rule
rules.body: Copper marks actions, selection, and primary observations; green and blue retain their distinct status and data roles.

rules.name: The Heading Face Rule
rules.body: Reserve Big Shoulders Display for headings; controls, metric values, tables, and prose use the system stack.

rules.name: The Ruled Surface Rule
rules.body: Keep data sections flat and separate them with fine rules; use a toned panel for grouped controls or contextual information.

dos: Do use the self-hosted display face for headings and the system stack for working text.
Do preserve copper actions, distinct data and status colors, and tabular numerical alignment.
Do keep report sections flat, with fine rules and restrained tonal groupings.
Do retain readable chart axes, contained scrolling, visible narrow-screen instructions, and inspectable values.
Do let long provenance and schedule identifiers wrap within their text columns.
Do preserve visible keyboard focus, native field behavior, and reduced-motion support.
donts: Don't apply Trusted Health branding to this personal transit project.
Don't shrink whole quantitative plots to fit a narrow viewport and make their axes unreadable.
Don't replace the inline SVG controls with text glyph icons.
Don't add decorative imagery or raised card treatments to the confirmed notebook world.
Don't style archive observation counts as inferred service, speed, ridership, or on-time performance.
